title: Eigenbounds of symmetric positive definite tensors
summary: This article introduces an algebraic framework for establishing eigenvalue bounds for symmetric positive definite tensors by leveraging intrinsic invariants, specifically the trace and determinant (resultant). We derive a hierarchy of inequalities via the Arithmetic Mean-Geometric Mean (AM-GM) inequality that yields progressively tighter upper and lower bounds for the tensor spectral radius and smallest eigenvalue. A comprehensive comparative analysis demonstrates that our invariant-based approach significantly outperforms classical coordinate-dependent methods such as the Gershgorin circle…
